question: Which food gives us quick energy to run and play all day? 🏃‍♂️
explanation: Super! Rice is an energy-giving food that keeps us active and ready to play! 🍚
hint: It is small, white, and fluffy.

question: What is the best drink for our body when we are thirsty? 💧
explanation: Awesome! Water cleans our body from the inside and keeps us very healthy! 💧
hint: It has no color and no smell.

question: Which body-building food helps our muscles grow big and strong? 💪
explanation: Great job! Milk is a body-building food that makes our bones and muscles very strong! 🥛
hint: Cows give us this white drink.

question: Which crunchy vegetable protects us from falling sick? 🥕
explanation: Fantastic! Carrots are protective foods full of vitamins that keep our eyes healthy! 🥕
hint: Rabbits love to eat this orange vegetable.

question: Which of these is a very healthy fruit for a sweet snack? 🍎
explanation: Brilliant! An apple is a fresh fruit that gives us lots of vitamins to stay strong! 🍎
hint: It is red and very crunchy.

question: Which yummy food is made from milk and makes our bones strong? 🧀
explanation: Excellent! Cheese has lots of calcium to make our teeth and bones super strong! 🧀
hint: Mice love to eat this yellow food.

question: Which of these gives us lots of energy to study hard? 🥔
explanation: Spot on! Potatoes are rich in energy and keep our brain and body working well! 🥔
hint: We use it to make healthy vegetable mash.

question: Which green leafy vegetable protects us from illness? 🥬
explanation: Perfect! Spinach is a green vegetable that gives us iron to stay super healthy! 🥬
hint: Popeye loves to eat this green leaf.

question: Which rich food gives us energy and is spread on bread? 🧈
explanation: Wow! Butter is an energy-giving food, but we should eat it in small amounts! 🧈
hint: It is yellow and melts when heated.

question: Which food from birds helps to build our body? 🥚
explanation: Amazing! Eggs are full of protein, which is perfect for building strong muscles! 🥚
hint: It has a white shell and a yellow yolk.

question: Which juicy fruit helps our body fight off a cold? 🍊
explanation: Super! Oranges have lots of Vitamin C to protect us from coughs and sneezes! 🍊
hint: Its name is the same as its color.

question: Which healthy food is baked and gives us energy? 🍞
explanation: Awesome! Whole wheat bread is an energy-giving food that is great for breakfast! 🍞
hint: We use it to make sandwiches.

question: Which body-building food is made from milk in our homes? 🧀
explanation: Great job! Paneer is Indian cottage cheese and it builds strong muscles! 🧀
hint: It is white, soft, and used in curries.

question: Which long yellow fruit gives us instant energy? 🍌
explanation: Fantastic! Bananas are healthy energy-giving fruits that are easy to peel and eat! 🍌
hint: Monkeys love this yellow fruit.

question: What must we do before we eat our healthy meals? 🧼
explanation: Brilliant! Washing hands removes dirt and germs so we stay healthy and safe! 🧼
hint: We use soap and water for this.

question: Which round flatbread gives us energy for the day? 🫓
explanation: Excellent! Chapati is made of wheat and gives us lots of energy to work and play! 🫓
hint: Your mother makes this round bread on a tawa.

question: Which body-building food lives in the water? 🐟
explanation: Spot on! Fish is a very good body-building food that makes our brains sharp too! 🐟
hint: It swims in rivers and oceans.

question: Which red vegetable is full of vitamins to protect us? 🍅
explanation: Perfect! Tomatoes are protective foods that keep our skin and body healthy! 🍅
hint: It is red, round, and used in salads.

question: Which sweet food from bees gives us natural energy? 🍯
explanation: Wow! Honey is a healthy, natural sweet that gives energy and soothes the throat! 🍯
hint: Bees make this from flowers.

question: Which root vegetable is sweet and gives us energy? 🍠
explanation: Amazing! Sweet potatoes give us healthy energy and are very tasty when roasted! 🍠
hint: It looks like a potato but tastes sweet.

question: Which bowl of food is rich in body-building protein? 🍲
explanation: Super! Dal is full of proteins that help kids grow taller and stronger! 🍲
hint: We eat this yellow or black soup with rice.

question: Which fruit is orange inside and protects us from sickness? 🍈
explanation: Awesome! Papaya is a protective fruit that is very good for our tummy! 🍈
hint: It has many small black seeds inside.

question: Which natural drink keeps us fresh in the hot summer? 🥥
explanation: Great job! Coconut water is nature's best drink to keep us hydrated and cool! 🥥
hint: It comes from a big green fruit on a tall tree.

question: Which rich golden food gives us lots of energy? 🧈
explanation: Fantastic! Ghee gives us a lot of energy and keeps our body warm and strong! 🧈
hint: We pour it hot over rice and dal.

question: Which tiny green beans are great for building our body? 🌱
explanation: Brilliant! Soybeans are one of the best plant foods to build big, strong muscles! 🌱
hint: They are small beans used to make tofu.

question: Which small bunch of fruits helps to protect our health? 🍇
explanation: Excellent! Grapes are sweet, juicy, and packed with vitamins to protect our body! 🍇
hint: They grow in bunches and can be green or purple.

question: What is the best way to eat our healthy food? 👄
explanation: Spot on! Chewing slowly breaks down the food so our tummy can digest it easily! 👄
hint: Use your teeth to make food very small.

question: What do we call a meal that has all types of healthy foods? 🍱
explanation: Perfect! A balanced diet has energy, body-building, and protective foods together! 🍱
hint: It means the right amount of everything.

question: Which healthy brown sweet gives us iron and energy? 🍘
explanation: Wow! Jaggery (gur) is much healthier than sugar and gives us lots of energy! 🍘
hint: It is sweet, brown, and made from sugarcane.

question: Which little green balls are body-building foods? 🫛
explanation: Amazing! Green peas are tasty and full of protein to build strong muscles! 🫛
hint: They come inside a green pod.

question: Which green fruit is rich in Vitamin C to protect us? 🍐
explanation: Super! Guava is a wonderful protective fruit that keeps our gums and teeth healthy! 🍐
hint: It is green outside and pink or white inside.

question: Which healthy drink made from curd keeps our tummy happy? 🥛
explanation: Awesome! Buttermilk (chaas) helps us digest food and cools our stomach! 🥛
hint: It is white, a little sour, and very refreshing.

question: Which big summer fruit is full of water and vitamins? 🍉
explanation: Great job! Watermelon gives us water and vitamins to stay safe in the hot sun! 🍉
hint: It is green outside and red inside.

question: Which yellow grains give us energy to play outdoors? 🌽
explanation: Fantastic! Corn is a great energy-giving food that is very fun to eat! 🌽
hint: It grows on a cob and is bright yellow.

question: Which cool food helps to build our body and digestion? 🥣
explanation: Brilliant! Curd (dahi) has good bacteria that keeps our tummy strong and healthy! 🥣
hint: We eat it with parathas or make lassi from it.

question: Which green vegetable looks like a small tree and protects us? 🥦
explanation: Excellent! Broccoli is packed with vitamins that help our body fight germs! 🥦
hint: It looks like a tiny green tree.

question: What is the best kind of food to eat every day? 🥗
explanation: Spot on! We should always eat fresh and clean food to stay healthy and active! 🥗
hint: It is newly made and smells very good.

question: What should we do to fruits before eating them? 🚰
explanation: Perfect! Washing fruits removes dirt and germs so they are safe to eat! 🚰
hint: We use clean water to do this.

question: Which of these is a healthy snack for school? 🥜
explanation: Wow! Roasted chana is a powerful body-building snack that makes us very strong! 🥜
hint: They are small, brown, crunchy chickpeas.

question: Which food builds strong bones and healthy teeth? 🥛
explanation: Amazing! Milk has calcium, which is the magic mineral for strong teeth and bones! 🥛
hint: You should drink a glass of this every day.

question: What helps our body digest the healthy food we eat? 💧
explanation: Super! Drinking plenty of water helps our stomach break down food easily! 💧
hint: We fill our bottles with this.

question: Which healthy breakfast gives us energy for the morning? 🍲
explanation: Awesome! Poha is made from flattened rice and gives us great morning energy! 🍲
hint: It is yellow, soft, and eaten for breakfast.

question: Which small crunchy foods build our brain and body? 🌰
explanation: Great job! Nuts like almonds and walnuts give us good proteins and healthy fats! 🌰
hint: Squirrels love to hide these.

question: Which yellow summer fruit is rich in vitamins? 🥭
explanation: Fantastic! The king of fruits, Mango, is very sweet and protects our health! 🥭
hint: It is yellow, juicy, and called the king of fruits.

question: Which healthy meal helps us grow strong and smart? 🍛
explanation: Brilliant! Dal and rice together give us both energy and body-building protein! 🍛
hint: We mix yellow soup with white grains.

question: Which green leafy food makes a healthy salad? 🥬
explanation: Excellent! Cabbage is a protective food that keeps our tummy very clean! 🥬
hint: It is round and made of many green leaves.

question: Which crispy food from South India gives us energy? 🥞
explanation: Spot on! Dosa is made from rice and dal, giving us energy and protein! 🥞
hint: It is a large, crispy, round crepe.

question: Which red beans are very good body-building foods? 🫘
explanation: Perfect! Rajma (kidney beans) are full of protein to make our muscles grow! 🫘
hint: They look like little red kidneys.

question: Instead of eating chips, what is a better healthy choice? 🥗
explanation: Wow! Fruit chaat is yummy, sweet, and packed with protective vitamins! 🥗
hint: It is a mix of cut fresh fruits.

question: What is a very healthy drink before going to sleep? 🥛
explanation: Amazing! Warm milk helps us sleep well and builds strong bones all night long! 🥛
hint: It is white and warm.
